study.question: Does retaining distinct raw and scaled/support-gated match-action summaries help beyond putting the same observed action summary in both slots, and does this depend on task-specific versus shared residual routing?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the r0039 single-row experiment substitutes stopped item summaries in the other row, so its both-minus-single benefit does not distinguish distinct scales/support from duplicating action exposure in the two active slots. r0037 task: observed both0.6661693800470533, item-duplicate both0.6636235974331053; r0039 raw-only0.6656788295393538, scaled-only0.6658103903314382. Corresponding shared values0.6646058217528154,0.6617347670710858,0.6634400442274656,0.6640824370132619. Both-minus-raw/scaled is0.000490551/0.000358990(task) and0.001165778/0.000523385(shared). Substitution interactions both-raw-scaled+itemdup are negative(-0.001696242 task,-0.001181892 shared), suggesting overlapping utility, not established synergy or independent information. Trajectory review: full action removal/context replacement r0024 gives0.641190/0.641430 versus incumbent0.666754; scorer-action removal alone r0025 retains0.666244. Summary rotation r0029 loses to its aligned endpoint; r0036 stopped item-duplicate0.663624 does not recover observed quality. Stopped observed r0037 versus stopped rotated r0038 drops0.002425769(task)/0.002628707(shared). Alignment/content dependence survives these implementations observationally, while original action-scorer and extra item-gradient explanations are weakened, not ruled out generally. Every retrieved trial here reports success, but candidate_diagnostics=not_requested; unsuccessful scientific branches are the zero/context, rotated and item-derived substitutions. No execution failures are fabricated. These runs share one seed and repeated validation access. The strongest imported click model remains g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached0.666753547526167 versus DIN0.6555440824200336, but its cart/fav/buy AUCs0.778878/0.787612/0.757167 are below DIN0.849070/0.864897/0.870182; no across-task improvement claim is justified. This round is attribution, not a claim to improve the incumbent. Mechanism hypothesis: example-dependent scale/support encodings of the same target-matched actions may improve readout beyond a repeated single encoding. If the observed both-scale endpoint exceeds raw/raw and scaled/scaled replacement controls at matched modules and stopped local derivatives, the advantage is consistent with this representation utility. If a duplicate matches or improves it, the need for distinct encodings is weakened. A difference in these contrasts across routing would support a routing interaction, subject to functional-capacity and optimization alternatives.

study.proposed_difference: Add only raw_duplicate and scaled_duplicate match_action_content modes. Raw/raw copies already-contracted action row0 into slots0/4; scaled/scaled copies row4 into slots0/4. Both selected outputs detach their source when match_observed_gradient=blocked; no item-summary replacement or extra derivative is introduced. Rows1/2/3, all item coordinates and every downstream gate are inherited. Four new standalone modules form a 2x2 duplication-source by routing factorial; existing r0037 observed endpoints add the natural raw/scaled reference, making the analysis a3x2 table. Existing r0039 one-observed-plus-item and r0037 all-item controls remain ancillary comparisons. This jointly tests scale/support, not their separate causes. HOST PREFLIGHT (pending; no tensor runner is exposed here and torch is absent): finite four-task train/eval forward/backward in FP32 and frozen BF16; confirm probabilities[B,1], finite summed BCE, same learned state keys/shapes, initialized tensors, RNG state and measured parameter counts (inherited expectation 32129765 total, 31793216 embedding, 336549 dense). At common state including a nonzero residual-bank output layer, inspect _match_action_content: raw_duplicate returns actions[:,0] in BOTH rows0/4; scaled_duplicate returns actions[:,4] in BOTH rows0/4, exactly in source dtype; rows1/2/3 unchanged. Neither duplicate reads item_summaries. With match_observed_gradient=blocked selected outputs have zero local derivative to incoming actions and item_summaries; ordinal outputs retain identity derivatives. A diagnostic attached setting must be forward-identical and send the sum of both selected output cotangents only into the selected source row. Test probes reading selected and unselected outputs; do not assert whole action-table gradients vanish because other paths remain live. For every existing content selector observed/item_duplicate/raw_observed/scaled_observed, compare new source at matching CONFIG to available materialized r0039 ancestor source at common initialization and nonzero residual state: require exact outputs, loss, buffers, dense gradients, coalesced sparse indices/values (including None versus zero), RNG state, and one frozen optimizer-step parity. Use the available ancestor instantiated with observed/blocked as the source-level bridge for the r0037 observed endpoint; existing receipt alone does not certify that bridge. Check all input/history/task masks, masked match IDs and coefficients/counts, item summary coordinates, scorer interactions/weights, compression populations and direct pools agree at common weights across new content modes. Target-action perturbations and masked in-vocabulary history ID/action perturbations must leave outputs invariant for empty, singleton, partial, noncontiguous and full masks; reject missing/malformed masks as ancestors do. New duplication cannot cross samples, histories, action/label boundaries or expose originally masked events. Raw/raw deliberately gives row4 the raw summary support, while scaled/scaled deliberately gives row0 the gated/scaled support; this effective action-slot support change is part of the intervention, not a change to any history/task visibility mask. Coefficient construction and item-coordinate gates remain unchanged. Availability/family gates must still zero disabled match rows after copying. Require inherited auxiliary parameter/embedding blocks and live context gradients. Exact equality for copied-row algebra, unchanged-method/common-state bridges and stopped-versus-attached forward outputs. Independent FP32 summary/coefficients references: rtol1e-5/atol1e-6; BF16: rtol0.02/atol0.002. Record residuals and fail attribution on excess; no score-informed retuning. Record training-only row RMS, raw/scaled support and changed-row fractions for diagnosis without fitting replacement scales. Equal AST/module sizes are not measured equal cost. predictions: For each routing r, define D_raw(r)=AUC(observed raw/scaled,r)-AUC(raw/raw,r) and D_scaled(r)=AUC(observed raw/scaled,r)-AUC(scaled/scaled,r). Hypothesis predicts both positive on full-population validation click AUC; record exact values without a single-seed significance claim. If only one is positive, utility is specific to the other encoding, not established need for both.

Define routing interactions I_raw=D_raw(task)-D_raw(shared) and I_scaled=D_scaled(task)-D_scaled(shared). Estimate both, with two-sided interpretation; their signs are not preselected. Consistent nonzero paired-seed effects would support dependence on this routing implementation.

If the latest both-minus-single benefit is only two-slot exposure/conditioning, at least one duplicate can recover the both-scale endpoint despite eliminating one distinct encoding. This competing prediction is admissible and can motivate a simpler representation.

At fixed parameters empty histories give identical predictions across new content modes. Distinctions require nonzero raw/scaled summaries with changed scale/support. Training-induced differences on empty-history validation rows are possible and are not direct information effects. No improvement of auxiliary tasks or incumbent click AUC is predicted.
falsifiers: Either duplicate matches or exceeds the observed both-scale endpoint across admissible paired repetitions: weakens necessity of distinct scale/support encodings; it does not refute historical action utility in pools or other summaries.

Effects vanish, reverse or vary substantially across paired seeds or user-cluster uncertainty: retain preliminary/null evidence; do not promote a single favorable validation comparison to a mechanism result.
No reproducible difference between D(task) and D(shared): weakens the routing-interaction claim for this implementation.

Failed bridge, derivative, masking, initialization, learned-state, auxiliary ownership or frozen-protocol check invalidates attribution irrespective of AUC. Changed measured compute precludes an equal-compute claim without additional comparisons.

Scale/support and feature RMS diagnose the result as conditioning/support coverage rather than new action information: revise the explanation; do not call the two proportional encodings independent information sources.
alternative_explanations: Duplicating a summary changes input covariance, support, magnitude and effective first-layer conditioning despite equal learned capacity; the primary hypothesis groups scale/support effects and does not isolate normalization from gating.

The original raw and scaled coefficients are proportional per example in exact arithmetic where scaled support is active; contraction/cast/reduction order can produce finite-precision differences. Neither two slots nor two magnitudes imply independent action information.

Selected-row derivatives are stopped but representations still co-adapt through live pool/ordinal paths; this is a training-from-scratch representation intervention, not a frozen-checkpoint causal estimate.

Task versus mean-bank routing matches parameter count/execution, but differs in functional capacity, gradient dilution and cross-task sharing; cannot equate routing advantage with semantic task specialization.

One shared seed, adaptive use of the same validation population, and missing candidate tensor diagnostics limit inference. Repeated receipt values from identical sources are deterministic bridges, not independent repetitions.

Whole-window vocabularies/static snapshots and possibly immature delayed feedback are inherited official_offline benchmark assumptions. These results cannot establish real-time causal utility or advertisement-specific conversion attribution.
The original four-task objective sacrifices auxiliary quality relative to DIN. A click improvement cannot be represented as general multi-task improvement.
